source.title: Precalculus: A Unit Circle Approach, 4th edition

concepts.title: 圆锥面、轴与顶点
concepts.summary: 直圆锥面由穿过固定顶点和底圆各点的所有直线组成，包含上下两个锥叶。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 底圆所在平面的垂线为轴，顶点在轴上；平面的位置决定交线。

en.title: The cone, its axis and vertex
en.summary: A right circular cone consists of all lines through a fixed vertex and a base circle; the full surface has two nappes.

method.title: Method
method.body: The axis is perpendicular to the base-circle plane, and the vertex lies on the axis. The slicing plane determines the intersection.

en.note: This source section is an overview with no numbered examples, practice problems or exercises. The next-page Getting Ready prepares Section 8.2.

concepts.note: 原书本节是概览，没有编号例题、配套练习或节后题。下一页Getting Ready属于8.2。

concepts.title: 四种非退化截线
concepts.summary: 不经过顶点的平面可截出圆、椭圆、抛物线或双曲线。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 垂直轴的平面截圆；斜截单个锥叶得到椭圆；平行某条母线得到抛物线；穿过两个锥叶得到双曲线。

en.title: Four nondegenerate sections
en.summary: A plane avoiding the vertex can produce a circle, ellipse, parabola or hyperbola.

method.title: Method
method.body: A plane perpendicular to the axis gives a circle; a tilted cut through one nappe gives an ellipse; a cut parallel to a generator gives a parabola; a cut through both nappes gives a hyperbola.

concepts.title: 退化截线与代数检查
concepts.summary: 经过顶点的平面可以截出一点、一条直线或两条相交直线。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 后续二次方程也可能表示空集或平行线；不能仅按二次项符号断言非退化曲线。无混合项的一般形式为 $Ax^2+Cy^2+Dx+Ey+F=0$。

en.title: Degenerate sections and algebraic checks
en.summary: A plane through the vertex can give a point, a line or two intersecting lines.

method.title: Method
method.body: A quadratic equation may also have an empty locus or parallel lines. Signs of quadratic terms alone do not guarantee a nondegenerate conic. Without a mixed term the general form is $Ax^2+Cy^2+Dx+Ey+F=0$.

concepts.title: 平面轨迹与应用
concepts.summary: 后续各节用距离定义在平面中研究圆锥曲线。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 椭圆的焦点距离和、双曲线的焦点距离差、抛物线的焦点准线等距定义，连接几何与方程。反射器和轨道模型需满足对应几何假设。

en.title: Plane loci and applications
en.summary: The following sections study conics as distance-defined loci in a plane.

method.title: Method
method.body: The ellipse distance sum, hyperbola distance difference and parabola focus–directrix equality connect geometry with equations. Reflector and orbit applications require their geometric assumptions.
